notes.title: The new Touring Karts BIG update is here!
notes.content:
[h1]New team colors, online tournament system, revamped garage and spectator mode added![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/5e6de3432cbd96386080355ff66d4e3b590fc222.jpg[/img]

The last big update for Touring Karts is ready for you to download:
[list]
[*]New team colors according to the last Season 2020.
[*]Enjoy 8 special daily online tournaments with unique great rewards every 3 hours.
[*]Totally revamped garage, now with car parameters and a new progression system based on the vehicle cards.
[*]New spectator mode, no VR device needed.
[/list]

Lastly, we want to remark the great review Touring Karts go from the guys at [url=http://www.cubed3.com/review/5783/1/touring-karts-playstation-4.html]Cubed3.com[/url], in which they praised our game as "a bit of a hidden gem", "a labour of love" and "a huge surprise and delight then to find fun gameplay, great music, and some real love put into each and every distinct track".

Hope you have a blast playing with the new features! Please let us know what do you think.

Enjoy the weekend.
Ivanovich Games.

notes.title: Update 95 is ready!
notes.content:
[h1]Update 95 is ready! [/h1]

With tons of improvements in the gameplay, circuit design, UI accessibility, visuals, also voice-chat is now compatible when playing with PS4 players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/4512d2ce3743dbd1284caa0831a496a8da44f470.png[/img]

- The turbo generated when drifting is much more powerful, and now it could be used to temporarily fly.
- The game now shows who's online and who's talking without needing to enter the menu. 
- New interface that displays more clearly the name, rank and level of the cars of all human opponents.
- Track changes (elevations, etc) are now slower and more gradual.
- The elevations in Russia, Australia, China and Germany have been moderated considerably. 
- New shortcuts in Japan and USA circuits.
- The size of many of the objects and items thrown around the track has been reduced (chicken, objects thrown by the monkey, like ice cubes, snooker balls, chocolates, etc).
- LIV avatar is now disabled by default.
- English translation has been polished, it is more polite.
- You can now catch a power-up right after using another one (no minimum timeout).
- Navigation through all menus is now much faster.
- Voice-chat is now compatible with PlayStation as well.
- Improved lighting for many scenes. Especially the night scenes.
- New option to make LAN games without the need of Internet (only in the ARCADE version).

News on the PlayStation version:
- Added integrated voice-chat.
- Force Feedback for Thrustmaster wheels.

Enjoy!
Ivanovich Games

notes.title: Touring Karts: Arcade edition
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that today we launch Touring Karts: Arcade edition.

[previewyoutube=EZhK8c1I7Pg;full][/previewyoutube]

These are some of the exclusive features of the commercial version:
- Simplified menus.
- All cars, circuits and accessories available without unlocking them.
- More accessible tutorials and help screens.
- Faster screen navigation without prize giving or missions.

Of course Touring Karts: Arcade edition also includes support for motion simulators, FFB Wheels and compatibility with Vive trackers. 
In addition:
- We will soon add more options such as the ability to create games remotely by console both multiplayer and solo.
- We are making a new exclusive circuit for Arcade edition to be used as training: With many fewer curves and generally simpler. It's not so much fun but it doesn't get motion sickness and can be perfect to start with.

Touring Karts Arcade Edition will be available on Springboard, SynthesisVR and Steam platforms. 

You can also contract the arcade licenses directly with us, so we can offer you cheaper prices: support@ivanovichgames.com

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]RAISE YOUR HAND![/h1]
The correct way to play Touring Kart with a motion controller is to raise your hand to catch the power-ups. If you play this way the experience will be more fun and immersive and the game will detect much better the later movement of throwing or drinking.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/965dc7aa9f31f539687af751a0a375086d35b876.jpg[/img]

[h1]CRAFTING POWER-UPS[/h1]
When you start playing all power-up fusions are blocked. But little by little they will be unlocked (fulfilling missions of the vending machine) and you will be able to create very crazy combinations. 
For example: If you take a chicken, don't use it! Try waiting to find an energy drink and it will automatically merge into a faster, more powerful red chicken. 
Get all fusions unlocked and you'll be the king of power-ups.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/fc3c173deb01a4f7b18ce011e1583c70350c50d2.jpg[/img]

[h1]VENDOR MACHINE & MISSIONS[/h1]
EVERYTHING in the game is unlocked by doing the missions of the gift vending machine. 
It is very important to choose the right circuit and think about the necessary strategy to face each mission. 
For example if you are asked to fly for 2 seconds you should choose a circuit that has a ramp near a descent to do so.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/10d2f5fc223e5bc6f8b1d07ed1c0e7a86a374654.jpg[/img]

[h1]MOTION SICKNESS?[/h1]
We know that all car games in VR can cause motion sickness. 
If you are a person sensitive to active dizziness go to configuration and activate the 2 anti motion sickness options that the game has. 
If you get dizzy we recommend that you choose the view specially designed to avoid motion sickness (the arcade machine view) with this view it is impossible to get motion sickness.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/cd0cf1228629a19eabf7befed544e7900d0b7f31.jpg[/img]

[h1]FLAT TRACKS?[/h1]
All the circuits in the game are inspired by real circuits. 
We have added impulse ramps and many other fun things but certainly only have ups and downs if the original circuit has ups and downs: Austria, US, Monaco, Japan, Belgium for example are circuits that have quite a few ups and downs.
If the game has enough community support we would like to make an additional pack of circuits that are not based on real circuits and where we can offer a more pronounced vertical component.

[h1]DRIVE WITH YOUR VIRTUAL HAND?[/h1]
In our game Operation Warcade we have this kind of control. Sounds cool and it's very immersive. But it doesn't work well in a fast karting games with ramps, ups and downs.
The human is being very bad turning a virtual steering wheel when it is under pressure and it is much more controllable a normal joystick using the motion controllers only for power-ups. 
We have tried in many ways and the result is BAD.

[h1]VIVE WANDS?[/h1]
You can use wheel + vive wand, keyboard + vive wand and we'll add also the option to use classic controller + vive wand. 
Any of these options works perfect. Especially wheel + vive wand. But use only Vive wands is not a good option for a car game. 
We have tried several combinations and this is the only control not recommended because vive Wands is the only motion controller without joystick.

[h1]WHEELS, FORCE FEEDBACK & CONTROLLERS[/h1]
The game should detect any controller and/or steering wheel. 
If the game does not detect your controller use the help button in the sofa room and write to support@ivanovichgames.com With this option we can add those devices that are not currently detected. 
On the other hand, if your steering wheel supports FFB we recommend install the drivers of the G29 steering wheel even if your steering wheel is different. 
https://support.logi.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360024850133--Downloads-G29-Driving-Force-Racing-Wheel

[h1]MULTIPLAYER & DISCORD[/h1]
We want to polish and improve the multiplayer to make it work perfectly. 
Since the game is cross-platform, we'll have more people playing as we add platforms. Check our discord and you'll get to know the community and you'll even be able to meet up and run against the devs.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/0ec2929b682d96e8ce607837cc5f87da1daced22.jpg[/img]

[h1]TELEMETRY & MOTION SIMULATORS[/h1]
The current version of the game send telemetry data using the standard UDP port: pitch, roll and speed.
It's also compatible with the official https://www.nextlevelracing.com plugin and the official https://simtools.us.

[h1]VR-ARCADE & COMERCIAL LICENSES[/h1]
We are creating a commercial version specifically designed to be used in VR-Arcades that includes a simplification of the menus, greater support for external devices (we have some very interesting surprise reserved here) and many options to be able to specify by parameter how you want the game to behave: direct online games, all cars unlocked, and so on.
Write to support@ivanovichgames.com and we'll send you the information as soon as it's ready.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/e1ab9f2fdf2c34b320caed8e958ed251d5562781.jpg[/img]

[h1]PLAYSTATION, MOBILE, QUEST VERSION[/h1]
The version of Playstation will be almost identical to that of the PC and will come out when we finish the Early Access of Steam/Oculus (Hopefully by the end of the year) including cross-platform working between PC and console.
The mobile version is also confirmed with cross-platform multiplayer versus PC and consoles.
Finally, if do you want play the game in Oculus Quest, you need your help here https://www.change.org/p/do-you-want-to-play-our-game-touring-karts-on-the-oculus-quest
Here you can check a gameplay of the PlayStation version working: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6UX_rMnFUIE
